definitions.explanation: The main subject or central idea of a work, discussion, or research. More formal and literary than テーマ.

examples.japanese: ⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主題|しゅだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}めた→決める：00858_kimeru⟧。
examples.english: I decided on the topic of my thesis.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主題|しゅだい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{家族|かぞく}→家族：00552_kazoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{絆|きずな}→絆：02509_kizuna⟧だ。
examples.english: The theme of this movie is family bonds.

examples.japanese: ⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{主題|しゅだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れない→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧よう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発言|はつげん}→発言：05099_hatsugen⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→下さい：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please keep your remarks on the subject of the meeting.

notes:
{主題|しゅだい} refers to the central subject or theme of a work, discussion, or research. It is more formal and literary than ⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {主題|しゅだい}{歌|か}: theme song
- {主題|しゅだい}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧: theme music
- {主題|しゅだい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{決|き}める→決める：00858_kimeru⟧: to decide on a theme
- {主題|しゅだい}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧: to stray from the topic

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧: theme (loanword, used in everyday conversation)
- ⟦{題名|だいめい}→題名：03421_daimei⟧: title (of a book, movie, etc.)
- ⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧: topic of conversation (more casual)
- ⟦{議題|ぎだい}→議題：11330_gidai⟧: agenda item (for meetings)

USAGE:
In everyday speech, ⟦テーマ→テーマ：17684_teema⟧ is far more common. {主題|しゅだい} appears in academic writing, literary criticism, and formal discussions. The compound {主題|しゅだい}{歌|か}/{主題|しゅだい}⟦{曲|きょく}→曲：09881_kyoku⟧ (theme song/music) is the most familiar use for most speakers.
